- Demonstrates understanding of consistency models and trade-offs
- Proposes practical, executable test scenarios with appropriate tooling
- Addresses all failure modes: data races, duplicates, lost updates
- Shows familiarity with distributed tracing and idempotent consumer patterns

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This evaluates understanding of idempotent API design, asynchronous workflows, and comprehensive testing strategies in distributed systems.

## Key Concepts
- Idempotency keys prevent duplicate operations
- Asynchronous job processing and status polling
- Input validation and error response design
- Concurrent request handling and race conditions
- Test isolation and data management
- Tooling selection for different testing phases

## Code Example
```javascript
// Jest test example
const payload = {cart: [{id: 'p1', qty: 2}], currency: 'USD'}
const headers = {'Idempotency-Key': 'abc-123'}

const response1 = await request(app)
  .post('/checkout')
  .set(headers)
  .send(payload)
  .expect(202)

const response2 = await request(app)
  .post('/checkout')
  .set(headers)
  .send(payload)
  .expect(200)

expect(response1.body.jobId).toBe(response2.body.jobId)
```
